head: RS
raw_text: It can be really tough to put your finger on what's wrong when you're feeling this way. Sometimes, just talking about it can help clarify things. Would you like to try to explore some possible reasons together? We can start with small things, like your daily routine, your relationships, or your goals. Sometimes, a small change or a new perspective can help shift things.
